title: Import your Goodreads data
intro: Download your data from Goodreads, then upload the favorite_genres and reviews JSON files. Your favourite genres, shelves and ratings are added to your Lexaria account. Importing the same files again won't create duplicates.

validation.fileSize: The file must be at most {{importFileMaxMb}} MB.

isbn.title: Import a book by ISBN
isbn.description: Fetch the details from Open Library, check them, then add the book.
isbn.source: Book details come from Open Library and are free to reuse (CC0).
isbn.noSynopsis: Open Library has no synopsis for this book.
isbn.exists: This ISBN is already in the catalog.
isbn.matched: The book “{{title}}” is already in the catalog, so this ISBN will be added to it as a new edition.
isbn.newBook: This book isn't in the catalog yet, so it will be added with this edition.
isbn.formatHelper: Filled in from Open Library when it lists one. Check it before importing.
isbn.pagesHelper: The number of pages, up to {{editionPagesMax}}.
isbn.coverHelper: Covers belong to their publishers. Only import one if you're allowed to use it.
isbn.noCover: Open Library has no cover for this edition.
isbn.editionImported: Edition added to the existing book.
